In the charging session below, there is a case of a Free of charge transaction.
We are receiving similar feedback from different customers, so we kindly request a detailed investigation.
In this case, the user started charging at 34% and finished at 97%, with a total energy consumption of 34.13 kWh.
However, the station sends the “StopTransaction” command only 20 seconds after the “StartTransaction” command. But the charging session is continue.
Because of this, it is shown as Free of charge on the backend side.
